note: M.D. of Bonnyville campground at 2301-1 Ave in Cold Lake North, a five-minute walk west of Kinosoo Beach (concession, water-sport rentals, splash park). A new park office and gate greet arrivals from 2026. Registered guests may use the boat launch at the north end. Dogs are not allowed on the beach at any time, and OHVs are prohibited in the park. --Claude
summary: Confirmed M.D. of Bonnyville campground on Let's Camp, 30-amp sites, potable water/flush toilets/coin showers/laundry/store. Wrote season May 8 - Sep 6 (2026, was derived ~May-Sep), booking (Let's Camp url, 14-night max), sites 152/max 70 ft/pull-through, hookups 30 A (no site water/sewer), facilities + dump; note rewritten. WATERFRONT: recommend lakefront -> lakeview. Rate UNREAD (no price on the M.D. page; Let's Camp closed until 2027). Phone found (780) 826-2245.
flags: WATERFRONT (stored lakefront - recommend DOWNGRADE to lakeview): the operator says 'From lakefront sites to walk-up tent sites'. The M.D. park map shows the A row (about A20-A43) on the road nearest the shore. On Esri imagery (0.36 m/px) the north-west part of that row (toward A43) sits inside a continuous band of spruce along the shore, and the south-east end (about A20-A25, where the trailers stand 20-30 m from the waterline) faces the park's own sand beach and swimming area - the map draws the beach strip and the 'Swimming Area (Unsupervised)' symbol right there, and the bylaw/terms say dogs are never allowed on the beach. A campground's own swim beach counts as day use (Leafy Oaks rule), so no site clearly passes the open-apron test; the SE-end sites do look straight across the open beach to the lake, which supports lakeview. Of those, A21 and A22 are capped at 22 ft on Let's Camp; A20 (32 ft), A23-A25 (24-27 ft) fit.

FEES UNREAD: the M.D. page posts no rates ('All prices are subject to GST and site fees'); Let's Camp's site records carry no prices out of season and the camp is closed to booking until 2027 (futureAvailableDates empty); the October 2026 Let's Camp read had no minimum price either. No rate written. RV Life tier $$ (stored).

PHONE (stored empty): Let's Camp lists (780) 826-2245 and ColdLake@md.bonnyville.ab.ca; the M.D. page gives the same 780-826-2245 for Vezeau Beach cabin bookings, so it is the M.D. parks line, not a campground office.
SITES: Let's Camp lists 152 bookable sites (138 power, 14 tent); the M.D. page and the Let's Camp bio both say '145 power and 14 non-powered' (159). Wrote 152. Bio also says '152 spots'.

PIN (54.47550,-110.19750): on the open lawn at the east end of the campground beside the beach/day-use area, within ~30 m of the nearest A-row sites; Let's Camp's point is 54.47464,-110.19582 (by the SE entrance). The loops spread about 600 m west of the pin, but the pin is inside the campground - no move.
WEBSITE: both stored lines answered 200 (M.D. page lists all 12 M.D. parks; the Let's Camp page is the campground's own). The M.D. bylaw 1864 has only penalty schedules, no rates.
SEASONAL: none at this park (the M.D.'s seasonal camping is offered only at Muriel Lake).
